title: BIAL responds to local jobs row, says Kannadigas form majority of workforce
description:
BIAL, which operates the Kempegowda International Airport here, said on Saturday that Kannadigas form the majority of its workforce and that its ongoing expansion will create more jobs for people from the state.
In a statement issued amid concerns over employment opportunities for locals at the airport, Bangalore International Airport Ltd said it was engaging with the relevant authorities and stakeholders to address the issues raised.
"Kannadigas constitute the majority of KIAB's workforce," it said.
The statement came a day after pro-Kannada outfit Karnataka Rakshana Vedike (KRV) held discussions with companies operating at the airport, seeking to enhance employment opportunities for Kannadigas as part of its campaign for greater representation of locals in private-sector jobs.
The airport operator said it was deeply rooted in Karnataka, with the state's identity, culture and aspirations reflected in the airport's art, architecture, design and passenger experiences.
